@@note: Spanish, made for the device's UI from the mobile app's (mstream_music, lib/l10n/app_es.arb, master bdb174e) and the terminal player's (mstream-terminal-player, locales/es.yml, main b89ad0a) translations where they had the text or the term (both GPL-3.0, the same author's; their words, register and typography are kept: informal tú), and translated by a Fable agent (Claude) otherwise. A machine translation, not yet reviewed by a native speaker: a review as a pull request on this file is welcome. Reviewed message by message by a second Fable agent against en.json's contexts and rooms (meaning, agreement, the apps' words, typography, the fit checker); still no native speaker's review. The rooms the notes give are those the texts were fitted to (42356b7); the layout fixes since gave most buttons and pills 2-4 px more and Small when their font doesn't fit, so a few of the apps' words a note set aside would fit now (docs/I18N.md, phase 3, lists them for a native review). The Auto DJ texts (October 2026, with the Auto DJ engine's UI) were made the same way: the mobile app's Auto DJ words (Auto DJ, Ancla, Seguir el ambiente, Mantener la semilla, Umbral de similitud, Continuidad de BPM, Mezcla armónica, 'desde aquí') and a Fable agent's translation for the rest, fitted with the same checker; not yet reviewed by a native speaker.
